description: The plot illustrates the MRR@10 metric for four different retrieval configurations across a varying number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)." and features a linear scale with data ranging from 1 to 10, displaying numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The "DPR w/o query" configuration is represented by a solid black line with no markers, which remains constant at a y-value of approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis from 1 to 10. The "DPR w/ corpus expansion" configuration is shown as a solid red line with circular markers; it starts at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 35.15, generally increases to a peak of roughly 35.79 at an x-value of 7, and ends at an x-value of 10 with a y-value of approximately 35.78. The "DPR w/ document expansion" configuration is depicted by a solid green line with upward-pointing triangular markers, beginning at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 34.78, reaching a slight peak of roughly 34.93 at an x-value of 6, and gradually declining to end at an x-value of 10 with a y-value of approximately 34.84. Finally, the "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" configuration is illustrated by a solid blue line with star markers; it starts at an x-value of 1 with a y-value of approximately 34.75, fluctuates to reach peaks of roughly 34.99 at an x-value of 2 and 34.98 at an x-value of 5, and then exhibits a declining trend to end at an x-value of 10 with its lowest y-value of approximately 34.37.
